storage: Airtight steel or glass jar, cool and dry, away from sunlight and steam; do not dip a wet spoon in.
looksLike: A brown to dark-brown fragrant powder, finer than whole spices, with warm cinnamon, clove, cardamom and coriander notes.
howToPick: A strong sweet-spicy smell when you open the box, a uniform colour and no lumps or damp. Some blends add salt or fillers, so check the ingredient list and sodium per 100 g.
shelfLife: Typically 6 to 12 months sealed from the pack date; use within 2 to 3 months after opening for best aroma (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Garam masala plus a little extra coriander and cumin powder
Whole biryani spices (cardamom, clove, cinnamon, bay leaf, mace)

usedIn.raw: 3 g per serving (1 tsp), in the chicken marinade
